founder: Leonid Boguslavsky (RTP Global — backed Datadog, Delivery Hero — and H-FARM founder)
format: Six-month, fully-funded, equity-free fellowship for founders building AI-native companies. 20-founder cohort. On-campus at H-FARM, Venice.
stage_structure: Application + AI-led async conversation → focused challenge → 2-step interview with admission committee
what_they_evaluate: What you've built OR what you're building
Personal competitive advantage — what you can do or see that most people in your field can't
Deep domain knowledge in a specific problem area
Unusual skill combination creating unique vantage points
Pattern of autonomous action showing outsized results
How AI changes your thinking (per stage 2 challenge)
what_they_emphasize: Capability over credentials — 'capability, not potential or credentials'
Evidence over polish — 'The bar is evidence, not perfection. Customers if you have them. Traction if you don't. Always the truth.'
Founders who 'see it too' — execution is becoming abundant, clarity is scarce
Comfort with operating phases: Discover → Define → Pretotype → Build → Execute → Scale (2-week gates)
Hybrid stacks: Tech (multi-agent, LLM eng), Business (term sheets, sales, hiring), Human (communication, emotional clarity, creative thinking)
Founder seriousness — they want people who could be running a company in 6 months
target_persona: Founder building (or already running) an AI-native venture with an unusual skill combination and a track record of autonomous output. Domain doesn't have to be technical-only — communication, product, design, business are all valid IF combined with AI-native fluency and execution.
audience_register: Direct, evidence-led, no fluff. The voice on the site is serif + monospace eyebrows + orange accent — confident, intellectually serious, not corporate. Match it: portfolio should read like a builder talking, not a candidate selling.
review_format: Stage 1 application (portfolio URL + CV + scored questionnaire, one-shot) → AI async conversation → challenge exercise → 2-step committee interview
test_or_followup: Yes — focused challenge in stage 2 evaluating reasoning and how AI changes your thinking
alessandro_fit_thesis: Strong. Already inside the H-FARM ecosystem (MSc + MARA in H-FARM Startup Center Pre-Accelerator). MARA is itself an AI-relevant marketplace play. Impact Puglia is direct AI-native comms work. The 'unusual skill combination' criterion is where his profile genuinely sings: communication-trained founder who can also ship product and integrate AI, with one foot in the H-FARM venture stack already.
narrative_pivots_for_naitive: Lead with what he's BUILDING (MARA) — present tense, not retrospective
Frame the comms-native origin as the COMPETITIVE EDGE, not the CV order
Show pattern of autonomous action: 5 distinct shipped projects in ~18 months, across product/AI/comms/events
Make the AI-native frame explicit: Impact Puglia + MARA's product surface + the master's program all sit on AI infrastructure
Connect H-FARM ecosystem fluency — he's already operating there, fellowship would deepen not introduce
personal_notes: Voice register chosen: founder/entrepreneurial. NAITIVE's voice is even sharper than that — closer to operator-direct. Calibrate one notch sharper than initial pass.
